notes.v0: BikeNetKit out of the box. A tag bug hides designated multi-use paths and cycle tracks: the tools see ~95 km of protected network instead of ~205 km.
notes.v1: Tag bug patched, no extra data. Baseline for comparison.
notes.v2: Bike crashes (Boulder PD, 2018–24) reweight Grow ordering and Fix gap ranking. Link unchanged.
notes.v3: Intra-city commute flows (LODES 2024) reweight Grow ordering. Fix and Link unchanged.
notes.v4: Crashes + commutes, 50/50 blend, reweight Grow ordering. Fix uses crashes (= v2). Link unchanged.
